title: 第20章 老贾：“魏沐，来乐视吧！！
content_zh:
第20章 老贾：“魏沐，来乐视吧！！-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

说起这个，其他女人眼睛纷纷亮了起来。

圈子里的女演员哪个不想拍陆串的戏，那可是下一个张一谋。

很多人或许看不起陆串太郎，但现在是2008年，陆串在国内的人气可不低。

其在2004年执导的《可可西里》，获得国内华表奖等多个奖项，还获得了东京国际电影节评委会大奖，是国内最炙手可热的青年导演。

魏沐对这个导演不怎么感冒。

先不谈他的屁股朝向问题，就说他拍的那些商业片。

有一个算一个，全是烂片。

《九层妖塔》和《749局》，着实把他恶心坏了。

尤其是后者，当年电影上映的时候他跟着一个小网红去看，结果人家小网红看到一半睡着了。

醒来以后还问他电影好不好看，魏老板一脸吃了shi的表情.....

不过嘛，魏沐还是要感谢他的，上辈子这位执导的片子可是给他贡献了不少流量，每次做吐槽他电影的视频都能获得不少播放量。

属于是流量来源。

秦兰撑着下巴，皱眉吐槽：“拍他的戏太累，一个镜头能拍十几遍，我眼睛都哭肿了。”

“那是他要求高。”

“对啊，眼光高的导演都是这样，你看看人家王家卫，不就是这样？”

熊乃瑾觉得她身在福中不知福，她们想拍陆串的电影还没机会呢。

对此秦兰没有反驳，但她就觉得怪怪的，有好几次拍了十几遍，最后还是选择第一个版本，不是耍人玩嘛。

几人聊了一会，霍斯燕看时间差不多，准备出去接人。

“老五马上来，我去接一下。”

“我跟你一起去。”

李晓璐跟着出去。

老五就是甘薇，也就是圈子里赫赫有名的【冰雪薇甜】的一员。

别看她年纪小，排名老五，却是泰迪姐妹团的重量级人物。

眼看着她们两人出去迎接，熊乃瑾忍不住吐槽：“老五还是牌面大啊。”

“可不是嘛，谁让她嫁了个好人家呢。”

肖雨雨这句话充满了酸味，魏沐隔着老远都能闻到。

作为大姐，秦兰当然不想团队里出现不和谐的声音。

她在中间打圆场：“行啦，老五运气好，我们应该恭喜她，以后她有什么好事也会想着我们。”

“这倒是....咱们可是好姐妹”

啧啧........魏沐看戏开心得不行。

要不怎么说泰迪姐妹团是塑料姐妹花呢，这才出去一会，就开始背后讲坏话。

有一说一，这个姐妹团友情甚至比不上仙剑四美。

说白了，她们就是嫉妒，可知晓未来的魏沐却没什么感受。

Speaking of this, other women's eyes lit up.

Any actress in the industry who doesn't want to film Lu Chuan's scenes is the next Zhang Yimou.

Many people may look down upon Taro Rikukushi, but it is now 2008, and Rikukushi's popularity in China is not low.

"Kekexili" directed by him in 2004 won many domestic awards including the Huabiao Award, and also won the Tokyo International Film Festival Jury Prize. He is the most popular young director in China.

Wei Mu didn't like this director very much.

Let’s not talk about the orientation of his butt, let’s talk about the commercial films he made.

One by one, they are all bad movies.

"Nine-Storey Demon Tower" and "749 Games" really disgusted him.

Especially the latter. When the movie was released, he followed a young internet celebrity to watch it, but the young internet celebrity fell asleep halfway through the movie.

After waking up, I asked him if the movie was good, and Boss Wei looked like he was in trouble...

However, Wei Mu still has to thank him. The films directed by this director in his previous life contributed a lot of traffic to him, and every time he made a video complaining about his movies, he would get a lot of views.

It is a traffic source.

Qin Lan held his chin, frowned and complained: "It was too tiring to film his scenes. I could shoot a scene more than ten times, and my eyes were swollen from crying."

“That’s because he’s very demanding."

"Yes, all directors with high vision are like this. Look at Wong Kar-Wai, isn't it like this?"

Xiong Naijin felt that she was so lucky that she didn't know how lucky she was. They wanted to make a movie about Lu Chuan but they hadn't had the chance yet.

Qin Lan didn't refute this, but she felt it was weird. She filmed it more than a dozen times several times, but finally chose the first version. She was not kidding.

The few chatted for a while. Huo Siyan saw that it was almost time and was ready to go out to pick up someone.

"Lao Wu will be here soon, I'll pick him up."

"I'll go with you."

Li Xiaolu followed out.

The fifth child is Gan Wei, a member of the famous [Bingxue Weitian] in the circle.

Although she is young and ranks fifth, she is a heavyweight in the Teddy Sisters.

Seeing the two of them going out to greet him, Xiong Naijin couldn't help complaining: "Lao Wu is still a big deal."

"No, she married into a good family."

Xiao Yuyu's words were full of sourness, and Wei Mu could smell it from a distance.

As the eldest sister, Qin Lan certainly does not want discordant voices to appear in the team.

She smoothed things over: "Okay, Lao Wu is lucky, we should congratulate her, and she will think of us if anything good happens in the future."

"That's right...we are good sisters."

Tsk tsk... Wei Mu was so happy watching the show.

How about saying that the Teddy Sisters are plastic sisters? After they went out for a while, they started talking bad things behind their backs.

To put it bluntly, the friendship between this sister group is not even as good as the Four Beauties of Sword and Fairy.

To put it bluntly, they were just jealous, but Wei Mu, who knew the future, didn't feel anything at all.
